tagline: Ek parivaar, kai projects - Netra by Prayagi Team

projects.name: Netra Battery Sentinel Pro
projects.summary: Android battery and charging readings, heat and charge-target alerts, consent-based power-saving tools, and last observed full-charge session history. Android/OEM limits apply; no guaranteed cooling, battery life or hardware charge cutoff. Missing readings show "Unavailable". Updates open the exact Netra Ecosystem page; BSPN does not download APKs.

projects.name: Netra KBC
projects.summary: An adaptive 17-question reasoning quiz game for Android.

projects.name: Netra Human Safety
projects.summary: Android safety dashboard with sensor tools, SOS, earthquake information and official IMD subdivision / NDMA CAP reports matched on the phone. Green reports stay silent; verified Yellow, Orange and Red IMD warnings can notify and speak. Checks are about 30 minutes, subject to Android delays, not every forecast or district nowcast. Beta/testing, not an emergency-service replacement; physical-phone delivery unverified. Updates through Netra Ecosystem only.

projects.name: Netra Privacy Guard
projects.summary: A dedicated privacy app for microphone and camera transparency.

projects.name: Netra Trikaal
projects.summary: On-device kundli, dasha, transits, a daily panchang card and rashifal from your saved birth profile. Hindi and English. Traditional interpretations, not scientific certainty or medical, legal or financial advice. Updates open the exact Trikaal page in Netra Ecosystem; Trikaal does not download APKs.

projects.name: Netra Player
projects.summary: Plays supported local video and audio files chosen on this phone. Optional usage reporting needs explicit opt-in; crash reports are previewed and sent only after a tap through FormSubmit HTTPS, not file-level E2EE. Updates through Netra Ecosystem; no package-install permission.
releaseInfo: v1.1.21: optional usage reporting requires explicit opt-in. Track-dialog lifecycle, audio-only labels, About and release metadata were checked with automated tests and rendered emulator screens.

Crash reports show their text and destination before a user-tap send through FormSubmit HTTPS. File-level end-to-end encryption is not implemented. Physical-phone, TV, Bluetooth and battery acceptance have not been verified.

projects.name: Netra Ecosystem
projects.type: All Netra apps in one place
projects.summary: Browse Netra apps in compact rows and dedicated app details. Known installed apps with verified newer releases appear in Updates; Update all queues checked downloads, then Android confirms each install. Package checks stay on the phone. Unknown data stays Unknown; no invented ratings or all-app inventory scan.
releaseInfo: v1.3.2 adds a dedicated Games tab. Current-catalog games and unreleased plans are kept separate. Planned Ludo (including Snakes & Ladders), Chess, Sudoku, Tic Tac Toe (confirmation pending) and an original match-3 game have no download or install action until released.

No new permission, dependency or network endpoint. Existing crash reports use a user-previewed HTTPS send through FormSubmit, not file-level end-to-end encryption. Physical-phone acceptance is not verified.

projects.name: Netra Charge
projects.summary: A very small free app that speaks four things: Connected, Disconnected, Full charge and Low battery (15% by default, adjustable). For Android, with a Shortcuts setup guide for iPhone.

projects.name: Netra Battery Guardian
projects.summary: Local battery and temperature observations, history, private report export and two home-screen widgets. Unsupported numeric data stays blank. No invented capacity, battery-health scores, Doze savings or storage categories. No guaranteed cooling, battery-life gain or Android OS security patches.
releaseInfo: v1.0.1: device-data corrections. Signed sensor current/power; counter-derived approximate capacity only with real inputs; Android-reported thermal alerts; measured cache and unattributed storage. Two widgets retained: detailed 4x3 and compact 3x1.

91 automated tests passed with native fixture previews. Physical-phone upgrade, widget resizing, voice routing and document-picker acceptance are NOT RUN. The signing certificate may differ from an earlier development build; Android may require uninstalling that build, which can remove local data. No cross-app history import is claimed.

upcoming.name: Netra Speak Clock
upcoming.summary: Separate time-announcement Android app in development, not released. Clock-aligned time-only TTS, screen-off operation, quiet hours and media/call rules. Build, unit tests and lint have passed in a candidate, but CI remains red on artifact quota; phone/Doze/audio reliability, production signing and privacy acceptance remain unverified. Earlier targets were missed; no new verified release time.
